caption: The drawing depicts a ring shown from three different views: the side, the front, and the top. The band and setting of the ring are rendered in a pinkish-gold color. The top view shows the ring's decorative elements arranged symmetrically, including a central round stone with a pale, slightly blue tint, flanked by two similarly shaped stones on either side; these stones are set higher than the rest of the design. Smaller green square stones are set at each corner of the ring's face, and there are additional small round white stones incorporated into the design. The side and front views illustrate the detailed band, which features ornate, leaf-like or scroll-like engravings extending down from the setting. The stones and intricate metalwork are highlighted with delicate shading and subtle highlights, giving depth to the overall composition on a plain, off-white background.
title: Ring
